arabic text: KARBOBALA NASEEB SE JANA NASEEB HO\nKARBOBALA NASEEB SE JANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: MAY I GET A\nCHANCE TO VISIT KARBALA

arabic text: PHIR LAUT KAR WAHAAN SE NA ANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: SUCH THAT I NEVER RETURN FROM THERE

arabic text: AISA DARE HUSSAIN PE, SAJDA HO AAKHRI
english translation text: MAY MY LAST PROSTRATION BE AT IMAM HUSSAIN’S DOOR…

arabic text: PHIR MUJHKO APNA SAR NA UTHANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: SUCH THAT I NEVER RAISE MY HEAD AGAIN

arabic text: PARWARDIGAR THOKRE DAR DAR KI KAB TALAQ
english translation text: O LORD! FOR HOW LONG WILL I STRAY FROM DOOR TO DOOR?

arabic text: AB MUSTAQIL NAJAF MEIN THIKAANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: MAY MY FUTURE ABODE BE IN NAJAF FOREVER

arabic text: JAISA MILA NASEEB SE UMMUL BANEEN KO
english translation text: THE WAY UMMUL BANEEN WAS BLESSED…

arabic text: AB KYA KISI KO AISA GHARANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: WILL ANYONE BE BLESSED WITH SUCH A HOUSEHOLD NOW?

arabic text: JEE CHAHTA HAI SAMNE BAITHE HO PANJATAN
english translation text: IT IS MY DESIRE THAT PANJETAN ARE SEATED IN FRONT OF ME..

arabic text: UNKI SANA UNHI KO SUNANA NASEEB HO
english translation text: SUCH THAT I CAN RECITE THEIR PRAISES INFRONT OF THEM
